layout_and_grid.navigation: Fixed sidebar navigation (240px wide) + sticky top header (64px high) with blur backdrop-blur-xl bg-zinc-950/90 (NEVER fully transparent)
layout_and_grid.dashboard_grid: bento-box modular layout using grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6
layout_and_grid.spacing_philosophy: Generous spacing (p-6, p-8, gap-6) with explicit internal card padding to prevent visual collision
layout_and_grid.mobile_responsive: Stack columns to grid-cols-1 on small viewports with collapsable sidebar drawer

srs_upload.style: Dual mode tab container (File Drag-and-Drop PDF/DOCX + Raw Text Paste textarea with line numbers). Feature AI Processing Indicator with glowing animated cyan boundary.

backlog_manager.style: Tabbed view by Epics / User Stories / Tasks. Dense interactive table/cards with priority badges (Critical/High/Med/Low), Story Point pill badges, skill requirements tags, and AI Confidence Scores. Review buttons: Approve All, Single Edit, Reject.

team_skills_matrix.style: Developer grid cards with skill tags, current capacity percentage meters (Progress bar with colored status: green <85%, yellow 85-100%, red >100%), availability toggle, and active workload assignments.

sprint_kanban_board.style: 4-column layout (Backlog, To Do, In Progress, Done). Drag-and-drop or status toggle cards with assignee avatar, story points, priority border left stripe, and dependency link icons.

dynamic_replanning_panel.style: Trigger Simulation Engine (Developer Unavailable, High-Priority Requirement Injected, Task Delayed/Blocked). Displays Side-by-Side Delta Comparison (Before vs Revised Sprint Plan) with impact metrics.

analytics_evaluation.style: Data-dense grid with Recharts visualizer. Charts for Precision/Recall/F1 score gauges, Story Point MAE comparison, Capacity Utilization histograms, Workload Balance radar/bar chart, Skill Match %, and Replanning Execution Time.

testing_guidelines.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive components, buttons, form inputs, tabs, modals, tables, user menu, navigation links, and dynamic cards MUST include unambiguous data-testid attributes in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a production-grade, highly cohesive React dashboard with Tailwind CSS and Lucide-React icons.
Ensure dark mode by default using rich zinc surfaces (#09090B main bg, #18181B card bg, #27272A borders).
DO NOT create simple or flat monochrome interfaces; use glowing cyan/indigo indicators for AI dynamic actions.
Use proper component separation under /src/components for SRS Processing, Backlog Review, Team Capacity, Sprint Board, Dynamic Replanning, and Analytics.
Implement mock API data fallback or live FastAPI integration so all buttons, uploads, triggers, and charts function interactively without blank or broken states.
Maintain strict data-testid tags across every interactive element as requested in test guidelines.
